WITH invoice_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS DECIMAL)) as avg_quantity,
    (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost)) / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) as relative_gap
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_quantity) as overall_average
  FROM invoice_stats
),
filtered_invoices AS (
  SELECT 
    i.invoice_number,
    i.avg_quantity,
    i.relative_gap,
    i.avg_quantity - o.overall_average as quantity_difference
  FROM invoice_stats i
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
  WHERE i.avg_quantity > o.overall_average
)
SELECT 
  invoice_number,
  avg_quantity,
  relative_gap,
  quantity_difference
FROM filtered_invoices
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
